title: CompactCraft
body:
### ❓ What is this modpack?
This modpack is an **optimization** modpack, it aims to get the most FPS possible on a potato pc, or just if you want to flex your high fps lol
It features Sodium, so if you want to, you can even install [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris/versions), if you want shaders!

### ⚠️ WARNING:
The efficiency of this modpack can be **unaccurate**, and performance may not be better. The modpack tries it's best to make the best performance possible, if you have any suggestions, hit me up on the github repo.

### 🃏 Questions, recommendations?
If you have any, hit me up on discord or on the github repo!
